question: How is the divine lotus visualized in relation to the first group of eight?
premises: The lotus is divine and eight-spoked.
It is adorned by a group of eight.
That group is identified as the first.
inference: The meditation envisions a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first group of eight.
plain_english: Visualize a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first group of eight.
